# Cohort Comms

> Official communications platform for the Hult Cohort Developer Program
> (Summer Pilot 2026, Week 2 winner). Channels, DMs, one-level threads,
> reactions, search, @mention inbox, typing indicators, image attach,
> unread/presence, light/dark — plus Forth board embed, deep-link cards,
> and a live inbound webhook receiver (Forth does not send outbound events).

## Links

- [Production app](https://cohort-comms-phi.vercel.app): sign in to the live cohort workspace.
- [Interactive demo](https://cohort-comms-phi.vercel.app/demo): no account; local-only interactive walkthrough.
- [Source code](https://github.com/priyanshshahh/cohort-comms): Next.js 16 app.
- [Forth project board](https://forth-bice.vercel.app): PM platform this integrates with.
- [Submission pull request](https://github.com/rogerSuperBuilderAlpha/hult-cohort-program/pull/118): cohort record.

## Stack

Next.js 16.2 (App Router), React 19, Auth.js v5 with GitHub OAuth, Neon Postgres via Drizzle ORM,
optional Vercel Blob uploads, deployed on Vercel. Realtime is SSE on
`/api/events` (poll max message id ~800ms) with SWR ~2s fallback while the
stream is down. Sidebar bootstrap ~5s; notification bell ~4s.

## Features (signed-in)

- Seeded channels: #announcements (admin-only post), #general, #project-2,
  #peer-review, #help; members can create channels
- 1:1 DMs; one-level threads; emoji reactions (👍 🎉 🔥 👀 ✅ ❤️)
- Postgres FTS search + ⌘K command palette
- Unread badges; presence (~2 min lastSeenAt); typing indicators
- @mentions → notification bell (mention / dm / reply)
- Image attach (Blob or data URL); Catch me up skim; light/dark theme

## Project management integration (Forth)

Forth publishes no public REST API and no outbound webhooks. Integration:

1. Inbound webhook receiver: `POST /api/webhooks/forth` with `x-forth-secret`
   (constant-time). Posts as Forth bot into a channel. Same-origin Forth URLs
   only; optional event_id dedupe + sentAt ±5 min window. Curl-verified;
   shipping on Forth does not auto-call this yet.
2. Embedded board: split-pane iframe beside chat.
3. Deep-link cards: pasted forth-bice.vercel.app URLs → labelled SPA hash cards.
4. Shared identity: same email / OAuth across tools (not technical SSO).

## Routes

- `/` — landing (public); signed-in → `/c/general`
- `/demo` — interactive product walkthrough, no account (public, local state)
- `/sign-in` — GitHub OAuth via Auth.js (public)
- `/c/[slug]` — channel (auth)
- `/dm/[userId]` — 1:1 DM (auth)
- `/api/bootstrap`, `/api/channels`, `/api/messages`, `/api/events`,
  `/api/search`, `/api/reactions`, `/api/notifications`, `/api/typing`,
  `/api/upload` — authenticated APIs
- `/api/webhooks/forth` — inbound board events (shared-secret auth)

## Not implemented

Message edit/delete, nested threads, group DMs, channel archive UI,
push/email notifications, automatic Forth → chat on ticket ship.
